findings.title: Cleanup plan stored pre-commit revision, so every fresh plan read as STALE
findings.evidence: debug execute → CLEANUP_PLAN_STALE on a just-created plan; fixed by two-phase commit anchoring post-commit revision
findings.impact: no EXECUTE plan could ever run (fail-closed, but feature dead)
findings.rootCause: plan.storageRevision captured before the planning commit bumped the doc
findings.recommendedAction: anchor to post-commit revision via non-bumping second phase
findings.after: S20/S21 green; stale plans still refused after real drift

findings.title: Manual override recorded reason text but kept the rule-derived decision value
findings.evidence: C10: override to REQUIRED persisted NOT_REQUIRED (value from rules, not the explicit human decision)
findings.impact: override path silently preserved the old verdict while claiming a new one
findings.rootCause: no forceDecision channel; manualOverride metadata did not drive the value
findings.recommendedAction: explicit forceDecision validated against the decision enum
findings.after: C10 green; override value + actor + snapshot link verified

findings.title: OWNED claims and licenseType grants passed without license evidence
findings.evidence: P5/P7: OWNED missing from the licensed list; licenseType never consulted
findings.impact: ownership/license claims persistable on identity refs alone (hash != rights)
findings.rootCause: evidence rule keyed on a subset of claim shapes
